title: TubeDETR: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding With Transformers

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Given an untrimmed video and a textual description of an object, spatio-temporal video grounding aims at localizing a spatio-temporal tube (i.e., a sequence of bounding boxes) for the target object described by the input text.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Our video-text encoder efficiently encodes spatial and multi-modal interactions by computing these interactions over sparsely sampled frames, and separately recovers temporally local information with a lightweight fast branch.

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: This is a challenging task that requires the joint and efficient modeling of temporal, spatial and multi-modal interactions.

methods.name: Object/Event/Spatio-Temporal Modules
methods.evidence_sentence: Given an untrimmed video and a textual description of an object, spatio-temporal video grounding aims at localizing a spatio-temporal tube (i.e., a sequence of bounding boxes) for the target object described by the input text.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: Inspired by these works, and the fact that attentionbased architectures are an intuitive choice for modelling multi-modal and spatio-temporal contextual relationships in videos, we develop a transformer encoder-decoder model for spatio-temporal video grounding, as illustrated in Figure 2.
